summary: Monday's close extended last week's volatility shock: growth names kept bleeding into defensive staples, long Treasuries rallied further, and bitcoin's drawdown deepened toward an 11% monthly loss. Gold fell in step with stocks rather than catching safe-haven bids, signaling broad deleveraging continued rather than a clean flight to any single asset.
tweet: Monday's close: vol stayed elevated, tech lost ground to staples and bonds, bitcoin slid further, and gold fell alongside stocks in a broad risk-off grind.
